properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 26 at 5:21AM EDT until August 26 at 5:45AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Straits of Florida from Ocean Reef to Craig Key 20 to 60 nm out...

* Until 545 AM EDT.

* At 521 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 29 nm northeast of
Floyd's Wall Northeast, moving northwest at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Prepare for wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, steep and fast-building
seas, frequent lightning, and blinding downpours. Stay low or go
below, and make sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

Intense and continuous lightning is occurring with this storm. Stay
low, or go below. Lower VHF antenna, outriggers, fishing rods, and
umbrellas.
properties.area: Straits of Florida from Ocean Reef to Craig Key 20 to 60 NM out

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 26 at 5:13AM EDT until August 26 at 5:45AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM
excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas...

* Until 545 AM EDT.

* At 513 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 32 nm east of
Floyd's Wall Northeast, moving west at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.
properties.area: Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas

properties.description:

Sidney Municipal Airport, or near Sidney, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Sidney, Colton, Sunol, Brownson, Lorenzo, Sidney Municipal Airport,
and Cheyenne County Fairgrounds.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.description:

* WHEN...Until 645 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin

fallen.

area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
